durationBasis.note: The label is a claim until the calibration batch times a real leg (protocol §8). The rule files carry the irregularities a real tree accumulates (numeric-string severities, spaced kind lists, a missing enabled, two deprecated markers, an extends pair with omitted keys), so a one-line sed does not finish the job; the semantics truth is the original tree's own loader output, computed by the evaluator from the seed tag.
